name: Longer Nano Pro 12W
tagline: Fast portable Longer: 12W with high traverse and rotary options
tldr: Longer Nano Pro 12W is a premium portable diode with very high advertised speeds and rotary/slide accessories. Niche machine for makers who need portability with more punch than 6W minis.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

priceRange.note: Official Longer store, Oct 2026: $560 to $970 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: F-theta field lens and 0.01 mm precision claim for crisp small marks
Two diodes: 3 mm basswood squares in ~6–10 min in our benchmarks
Fills at ~60–150 mm/s, with galvo moves rated up to 5,000 mm/s
cons: Small 100 × 100 mm field unless you add the slide extension
Pricing varies widely between Longer's store and resellers: compare bundles
Galvo cutting builds depth through many passes, so thick cuts stay slow
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 12W SKU on Longer Nano Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.

editorialDepth.advantages: Longer Nano Pro 12W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 5 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.

faq.question: What does the field lens change on the Nano Pro 12W?
faq.answer: The Pro pairs two diodes with an F-theta field lens, which keeps the spot focused across the galvo field. Longer quotes 0.01 × 0.01 mm engraving precision for the Pro against 0.05 × 0.05 mm for the 6W, which shows on small text, QR codes and photo detail.

faq.question: How thick can the Nano Pro 12W cut?
faq.answer: Longer gives a 10 mm wood cutting depth. In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 6–10 min at 4–10 mm/s, and basswood up to about 5 mm is realistic. The 100 × 100 mm field (100 × 300 mm with the slide) limits part size more than power does.

faq.question: How much does the Nano Pro 12W cost?
faq.answer: Longer's own store listed it from $559.99 (Basic) to $689.99 (Pro set or Extension pack) and $969.99 (Pro Max set) in October 2026. Reseller and bundle prices vary widely, so compare what each set includes before buying.
